# Vault index

Catalog of every page. Format: `- [[<type>/<title>]] — short one-line hook`.

## Entities

- [[entities/proj-active]] — flagship active project
- [[entities/proj-incomplete]] — missing goal/next_action
- [[entities/proj-overdue]] — due and next_review both in the past
- [[entities/proj-no-review]] — next_review absent
- [[entities/proj-nodesc]] — description absent
- [[entities/proj-badpara]] — invalid para value
- [[entities/proj-archived]] — para: archive, excluded from queues

## Overviews

- [[overviews/area-main]] — the only area page

## Summaries

- [[summaries/note-proj-active]] — pre-existing notes for the active project
- [[summaries/dangling-project]] — points at a missing project page
- [[summaries/packet-good]] — valid packet entry
- [[summaries/cited-summary]] — cites the raw source

## Concepts

- [[concepts/area-note]] — links to the area
- [[concepts/new-undescribed]] — new page missing description
- [[concepts/packet-bad]] — invalid packet value
- [[concepts/problem-fp1-fed]] — recently fed fp-1
- [[concepts/problem-fp9-ref]] — references an untracked fp id
- [[concepts/candidate-stale]] — archive candidate
- [[concepts/candidate-mentioned]] — archive candidate only with a tighter threshold
- [[concepts/candidate-superseded-linked]] — has a backlink, never a candidate

## Synthesis

- [[synthesis/favorite-problems]] — favorite problems catalog
